messages:
Samira: Pushed release v2026.3.7 to prod (canary = 2%). Can we do a quick post-deploy smoke sweep and confirm release notes are good for marketing?

deploy-bot: roll started -> canary: 2% traffic, health-window=2m, probes=embed_synth,kv_prefill. will post probe results here.

Oliver: running quick health curl + tracer check
Oliver: `curl -sS https://api.redwood-inference.prod/health | jq .status` -> \"ok\"

Tara: synth embed probe p95 (last 5m) = 48ms, error rate = 0.00% :thumbsup:

Lee: seeing a small tokenizer WARN from one host in us-west1 at 15:42, not 5xx. snippet: `WARN tokenizer: unexpected byte sequence, fallback to bytepair` — investigating but not blocking.

Nina: FYI threshold: if canary error_rate > 1% or p95 increases > 20% vs baseline -> rollback plan A (pin to v2026.3.6 + abort ramp). Also if prefix-kv misses spike > x10, pause ramp.

Samira: ack. Oliver — can you kick off a small replay job against the canary with our smoke prompt set? want token-level latencies and top-10 failing prompts.

Oliver: kicking off `/deploy replay --target canary --job canary-smoke-2026-03-23 --samples smoke_prompts_v2` now. ETA ~4m. job id=7890.

deploy-bot: replay job 7890 started. will stream results here.

deploy-bot: replay job 7890 finished. summary: error_rate=0.14%, p50=22ms (+2ms), p95=51ms (+4ms). top failures: 3/2145 timeouts (transient), no consistent model regressions.

Samira: good — numbers are within tolerance. I'm going to ramp to 10% in 10m if no new anomalies. updating release notes: added note about small tokenizer fallback optimization and the new batching knob documented.

Alex (CS): pinging CS and marketing to review release notes draft. small breaking note in default margin param — flagging customers on enterprise plans.

Oliver: tracing shows one 500 from instance i-0a9f during replay; created ops ticket OPS-4567 and disabled that host from the pool. instance-level cause looks like OOM on quant decoder, investigating.

Lee: OOM trace attached to OPS-4567. I'll follow up with runtime/infra. not seeing wide impact.

Nina: if OPS-4567 impact widens, we do immediate rollback + emergency pin. Otherwise proceed with ramp plan.

Samira: thanks. I'll wait 10m, re-check synth p95 and errors, then ramp to 10% and update the release channel + release-notes link. tagging @deploy-oncall to watch the next window.

deploy-bot: ramp scheduled -> to 10% at +10m from 1781234567. will post confirmation when complete.

Oliver: noted. posting follow-up logs and quick grep results to the thread. `grep -i oom /var/log/runtime.log | tail -n 50` shows the one noisy instance only.

Samira: closing the quick check for now. keep thread if you see anything odd, otherwise I'll announce ramp complete and push release-notes url shortly. :rocket:
